resources.string: Each person with the link can send a request, and you accept each one. A reusable link has no first-open lock. Your device ends a timed link when it is online.
Each contact gets one piece of the social half of your recovery code. You keep the user half.
If you accept, this chat no longer recovers from an earlier break-in.
Revocation acts on the future only. A revoked device keeps the data that it synced.
Anyone in this chat can copy, photograph, or save a message before it disappears.
A message arrives at once. Google learns when each one arrives.

This deletes the message on the device of each member. You cannot undo this. Each member sees that you removed a message.
